app.name: VenuBoard
app.tagline: Modular websites and management for venues

shell.scaffoldNotice: Scaffold only — no business functionality is implemented yet

home.title: Application scaffold
home.description: This is the VenuBoard application shell. It renders routing, layout, internationalisation and environment handling — and nothing else. There is no database schema, no authentication, no permissions, no Row Level Security and no modules.
home.surfacesDescription: The three documented surfaces exist as labelled placeholders so the routing separation is real from the first commit.
home.nextStep: The next phase is the first database migration. Before it is written, the decisions listed in the repository documentation must be reviewed.

publicVenue.title: Public venue site
publicVenue.notImplemented: Tenant lookup is not implemented. This page shows the slug taken from the URL and nothing more: no venue record is loaded, no modules are resolved, and no entitlement or publication state is checked.
publicVenue.routingNote: Production will resolve a venue from its verified custom domain first, then its VenuBoard subdomain, and keep this path as a permanent fallback.

admin.title: Venue administration
admin.notImplemented: Authentication and active-venue selection are not implemented. There is no sign-in, no membership loading, no venue switcher and no navigation generated from entitlements.
admin.scopeNote: Once built, this surface will only show modules that are both entitled by the platform and enabled by the venue.

platform.title: VenuBoard platform administration
platform.notImplemented: Platform authentication and authorisation are not implemented. There is no platform role check, no multi-factor requirement, no audited support session and no tenant creation.
platform.scopeNote: Platform roles live separately from venue memberships and are never granted by tenant users.
